newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government sends adequate food stocks to northern Jaffna to meet needs of people during festive season.
Oruwala Steel Corporation workers agree to return to work only if police deployed at factory are removed immediately, labour unions tell Labour Minister Mahinda Rajapakse.

Security forces on offensive against Tamil Tiger rebel bases in east capture guerrilla administration centre in Kokkaddicholai. Tigers ran a police station and courts and taxed residents before withdrawing ahead of advancing troops.
Tamil Tiger rebel suicide bomber on motorcycle kills Special Task Force police commando, senior superintendent of police Upali Sahabandu, in east by ramming his jeep.

Twenty-five Tamil Tiger rebels wounded in last week's raid on Pulukunava Special Task Force camp succumb to their injuries raising guerrilla death toll in attack to 51. Wounded rebels were treated at Vakarai rebel hideout and then taken by boat to Mullaitivu.
